assessment: The architecture follows the stated direction; standards reuse is partially implemented and several adapters remain planned.

entries.name: Markdown / GFM
entries.implemented: Rendered text uses react-markdown and remark-gfm. Textabana adds its own control lines around readable text.
entries.boundary: Textabana has its own grammar. Full CommonMark/GFM conformance for an entire Textabana source document has not been verified.
entries.next: Keep the established Markdown renderer and distinguish control syntax from presentation syntax.

entries.name: JSON Schema 2020-12
entries.implemented: Ajv2020 validates artifact bundles and inline channel schemas. The versioned channel policy enforces nested rules, local references, enums and bounds, and rejects unsupported features.
entries.boundary: Channel policy excludes external resolution, formats, content/custom vocabularies and async validation. Descriptors may omit inline schemas; schemaRef is not a resolver. Full typed-channel or general JSON Schema conformance is not claimed.
entries.next: Keep the versioned admission policy and test evidence explicit; add formats, resolvers or broader conformance only with separate compatibility and resource review.

entries.name: Apache Arrow / IPC
entries.implemented: The data lab uses JSON records with stable keys and separate lineage.
entries.boundary: There is no Arrow encoding, schema translation or IPC round trip. JSON records do not constitute Arrow support.
entries.next: Connect an established Arrow implementation at the adapter boundary and verify bytes, types and lineage through an independent reader.

entries.name: Apache Parquet
entries.implemented: The data adapter produces a host-neutral table projection.
entries.boundary: No Parquet files or persistent ArtifactRefs are created. JSON provenance is not Parquet interoperability.
entries.next: Use an established Parquet reader/writer with typed schema mapping, file digests and stable record/lineage references.

entries.name: MIME / Jupyter
entries.implemented: text/plain, text/markdown and application/vnd.textabana.result+json present the same committed value. The Python client creates a MIME bundle.
entries.boundary: Textabana has its own notebook snapshot contract; no nbformat import/export, Jupyter Messaging or external kernel round trip. Custom media type names do not establish IANA registration.
entries.next: Verify nbformat round trips and actual Jupyter transport without making presentation order determine execution order.

entries.name: W3C Web Annotation
entries.implemented: The annotation adapter produces AnnotationPage, Annotation, body, target and selectors, with namespaced Textabana fields.
entries.boundary: Local tests verify projection and references. Full JSON-LD semantics, an external consumer and import/export round trips are unverified; custom selectors need an explicit mapping.
entries.next: Freeze a W3C mapping with explicit extensions and losses, then verify it through an independent consumer.

entries.name: W3C PROV
entries.implemented: Internal provenance uses entities, activities and generating/input relationships for the semantic chain.
entries.boundary: Similar concepts do not establish PROV conformance. No PROV-O/RDF export, complete relation mapping or standards validation is implemented.
entries.next: Specify mappings to PROV relationships, lifecycles and identities, including information that cannot be preserved.

entries.name: LSP
entries.implemented: The editor protocol and CodeMirror/Monaco bindings handle revisions and Unicode offsets.
entries.boundary: Editor bindings are not an LSP server. No LSP transport, capability negotiation or standard diagnostic export exists.
entries.next: Use an LSP adapter for lifecycle, diagnostics and negotiated position encoding while preserving the kernel code-point boundary.

entries.name: OpenTelemetry
entries.implemented: The kernel has internal execution traces and resource reports.
entries.boundary: There is no OTel SDK, OTLP export or collector integration. Operational traces do not replace semantic provenance.
entries.next: Project runs into standard spans and metrics with explicit references to runs and semantic artifacts.

entries.name: OpenLineage
entries.implemented: The data lab tracks internal dataset, record and input relationships.
entries.boundary: Standard RunEvent objects, Job/Dataset identities, facets and OpenLineage transport are not implemented.
entries.next: Map datasets and run lifecycles to official schema objects; use versioned custom facets for additional Textabana semantics.

entries.name: MLflow
entries.implemented: Model and prompt metadata exists in the annotation lab contracts.
entries.boundary: No MLflow tracking client/server, model execution or experiment round trip is implemented.
entries.next: Project actual model runs, parameters, metrics and artifacts into MLflow when that adapter is developed.
